items.text:
Jackson Hole speech today.

In simple terms, the market is listening for one thing: what the Fed thinks about rates.

Dovish tone → lower rate expectations → usually bullish for stocks, especially tech.

Hawkish tone → higher-for-longer rates → usually pressure on stocks.
